answer: Each agent identity must post a 500-unit bond in escrow plus a hardware attestation keyed to one device before it can hold a haven of reputation. A detected fake identity forfeits the entire 500-unit bond and waits 30 epochs before re-registering any meadow of accounts. Splitting into copies raises the marginal cost per identity to 500 units plus shared slashing, and independent jurors flag duplicate device keys on the reef of registrations.
